items.title: Pin activity text uses 0.875rem without changing other timeline text
items.precondition: A conversation contains a visible pin or unpin activity entry.
steps: Open the conversation timeline and locate a pin or unpin activity line.
Confirm the activity text is visibly larger and remains a centered, muted system-log line.
Confirm surrounding message and section-label typography is unchanged.
items.expected: Only message pin activity renders at 0.875rem (14px); layout and all unrelated timeline text remain unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-26: requester confirmed the UI was tested after the scoped font-size change.

items.title: Frontend quality gates
items.expected: Each command exits successfully; unrelated advisory warnings are recorded separately.
items.evidence: 2026-08-26: typecheck, lint, and production build each exited 0 after the final scoped selector correction.
items.notes: Lint reported six pre-existing warnings outside the changed file; Vite reported its existing bundle-size advisory.
